description: Start a short-lived HTTPS (TLS) CONNECT proxy session for the member who owns the agent key. Returns proxy host, port and a 15-minute credential. Usage is charged to the member's own data. Ends the member's other active connection.

max_mb.description: Megabytes. Cannot exceed the key limit.

region.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. US. Omit for automatic.

name: start_session
title: Start a proxy session
